Etherlords: Skills

Hero skills of the game. A hero learns at most five, each up to rank 3.

15 pages. Select a name for its page.

  • Ethereal Attack
  • Ethereal Defense
  • Learning
  • Looting
  • Luck
  • Mobility
  • Regeneration
  • Resources

Names, descriptions and values come from the game's own data.
